action: Reviewed older close, inspect and chase captures of Kit and traced its Ceres crew role, motion and LOD package records.
observation: The rescue-skiff silhouette and empty patient mounts communicate its role; the broad deck shows repetitive flat tile detail. These screenshots are from October 24 and may not represent the current renderer. The separate LOD resources have about 5.3k, 2.45k and 1.42k triangles, with 11 primitives each; that is not a measured frame draw count.
decision: Preserve the recognizable rescue-deck shape and moving lamp/socket contract; do not change the model based on historical captures alone.
next: Capture current renderer views, including the gameplay camera, before deciding whether the surface needs a targeted treatment.
evidenceScope: Historical images plus static route, source and package metadata; not current player-route acceptance.
performance: Separate LOD resources reduce triangle counts; no submission, frame-time or GPU benefit measured.

variantCoverage.note: Historical capture of the primary file; current renderer review pending.
